name: proxq
description: Redis-backed async HTTP proxy queue built on asynq — submit any request, get a job ID back instantly, poll for status, and fetch the replayed upstream response.

proxq_url.title: proxq URL
proxq_url.description: Base URL of your running proxq instance (PROXQ_URL), e.g. http://localhost:8080. proxq ships with no built-in authentication.
